BL-857 — Test sandboxes launch cloudflared against the production tunnel name and orphan it, because the reap is scoped to a pidfile inside the sandbox's own deleted tree
What it solves: Sequencing matters more than usual here: BL-762 is ACTIVE and edits
`stop_ancillary_services.sh`, which this ticket also edits. Do not promote
this into a slot alongside it.
Approval context: One decision worth a tap: whether a run outside the operator root should be REFUSED the production tunnel name outright (scenario 03), or merely be required to clean up after itself.
I specced the refusal, because the cleanup half alone cannot hold: the incident's twelve orphans were disowned preci…
BL-857 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-857" (or "reject BL-857 <reason>") to act.
